How to travel cheap

Cheap travel is a skill, not luck. Plan your dates, fly light, and use free tools to compare before you book.

  • Compare prices free. Google Flights (google.com/travel/flights) and Skyscanner (skyscanner.com) both cost the same to you.
  • Fly mid-week. Tuesday and Wednesday are often cheaper than Friday, Saturday, or Sunday.
  • Fly at dawn or late night. These seats are often cheaper.
  • Set a price alert. Many sites let you do this free.
  • Fly light. A small backpack fits under the seat. Many airlines charge for bags.
  • Stay off tourist season. Shoulder season is cheaper and less crowded.
  • Use free tools. Do not pay a travel agent to compare prices — the free sites do it.

Honest note: we are not signed up for any flight-booking affiliate program. The links on this page are plain links — we do not earn a commission if you book.
